A '''diamond boots''' is the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] [[Armor#Boots|boots]], crafted from [[Diamond|diamonds]]. It gives 3 armor and 2 toughness and has 800 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/diamond_boots.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which sets the stats shown in the infobox.

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 3 armor, 2 armor toughness. The vanilla item gives 3 armor with 429 durability.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Diamond|diamonds]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Diamond|diamond]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/diamond_from_blasting_diamond_materials.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Armor durability and protection were made consistent across tiers (leather < copper < gold, sturdy leather < iron, shakudo, hepatizon, steel < diamond, electrum < adamant). Added translation support for all armor and tools.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Diamond ores now drop [[Raw Diamond|raw diamonds]], which must be smelted in a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]].}}
}}
